title: new-extreme-1996-intercontinental
label: Eddie Jacobs

won.source: Won the title from Balial in a Crucifix Match at King of the Mat 2.

note: Successfully defended against Ian Walsh at Friday Night Slam Dance (24 April 1998) in a match that ended without a finish when Walsh turned on his own stable to join Jacobs's.

won.source: Already N.E.W. Intercontinental Champion entering the held record; no document read this pass dates the reign's start.

lost.source: Lost the title to Eddie Jacobs in a Crucifix Match at King of the Mat 2.

won.source: Won the title in a Four Way Dance also involving James Pillow, Assaf Levavy, and Brass Knuckles at Friday Night Slam Dance, pinning Pillow after stablemate Steve Miller struck Pillow with the championship belt.

Already N.E.W. Heavyweight Champion entering the held record; the promotion's own King of the Mat 2 broadcast credits the win to a steel-cage match over James Pillow, undated within what this pass read.

lost.source: Lost the title to Vinny Vitrone in a Four Way Dance also involving James Pillow and Brass Knuckles at Friday Night Slam Dance, after suffering an in-match knee injury.

title: new-extreme-1996-north-american
label: "Stylish" Steve Miller

won.source: Already N.E.W. North American Champion entering the held record; a separate document read this pass names Brass Knuckles as an earlier 1998 holder of the same title, but no document read this pass dates the bout in which Miller won it.

note: Successfully defended against Drew Snyder at King of the Mat 2 (6 April 1998), a match restarted once after an initial disqualification finish, then decided by interference from an ally known only as the Masked Man.

won.source: Won the N.E.W. Tag Team Championship Tournament final over Vinny Vitrone and Apocalypse at King of the Mat 2.
